vey3zpmc.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
vey3zpmc.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
vey3zpmc.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 6ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine. This beautifully full 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 400 multi-function warm white LED lights, creating a charming centrepiece for your Christmas celebrations. Featuring the distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage found in our Matterhorn Pine range, the Wildhorn Pine also has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These help fill gaps and add depth, while the realistic outer branches give the tree its natural appearance. With 1,298 tips and a width of 105cm, there is plenty of foliage to showcase your favourite decorations. We love its gently upswept branches and classic, tapered shape, with natural shades of green and subtle brown detailing adding character throughout. The warm white LED lights highlight the texture of the needles, while their multi-function settings let you choose the lighting effect to suit your festive display. The tree comes in three sections for assembly. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Due to the prickly nature of the realistic pine needles, we recommend wearing long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing your tree. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 6ft • Pre-lit: 400 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 1,298 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 105cm diameter • Assembly: Three-section tree • Stand diameter: 55cm • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Carton dimensions: 106cm × 34cm × 36cm • Weight: 14.5kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

qenx7gky.baseName: COSTWAY 5FT Pre-lit Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree With Lights-Pink
qenx7gky.variantName: COSTWAY 5FT Pre-lit Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree With Lights-Pink
qenx7gky.sourceDescription: Featuring a soft pink hue that adds whimsical elegance, this artificial pencil tree brightens your festive decoration with a unique touch. With snow-dusted branch tips, the pre-lit Xmas tree beautifully captures the essence of winter's magic in your home. Flocked tree care: a little flocking may shed during first setup, gentle handling works best! Enhanced by warm white LED lights controlled via a light controller, it offers 8 sparkling modes(combination, in wave, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on), allowing you to tailor the ambience to any occasion. Made from flame-retardant, non-allergenic PVC, this realistic fir tree combines durability with safety. The base includes a single bolt for straightforward and precise assembly. A pair of gloves is also provided, ensuring a smooth setup process while protecting your hands. Note: Ornaments are not included. Charming & Lifelike Appearance: Featuring snowy branch tips, the slender Christmas tree captures the spirit of winter celebrations. With charming pink leaves, it combines icy elegance with a dreamy look to make your space feel warm and inviting. Adjustable Lighting Modes: Equipped with warm white LED lights, this artificial Christmas tree adds instant festive glow. A controller lets you choose from 8 adjustable lighting modes to match different events and moods. The UL-listed adapter helps ensure safe and reliable use. High-Quality PVC Material: Made of flame-retardant, smell-free, and allergy-proof PVC, this holiday decoration is designed with safety in mind. In addition, the selected material is non-fading, keeping it beautiful for years. Hassle-free Assembly & Storage: The slim Xmas tree is designed with 2 detachable trunks and folding metal stand for easy post-season storage. Moreover, the metal stand features a pre-installed bolt for quick and precise alignment. Plus, a pair of gloves is included for a stress-free assembly experience. Space-saving Pencil Shape: The hinged holiday tree is not only a stunning centerpiece, but also a practical space-saver for offices, malls, and cafes. Its slender shape allows it to fit neatly into corners while still offering a full winter appearance. Specifications Color: Pink Material: PVC, Metal Product Dimensions: 40 x 150 cm(Dia. x H) Tree Height: 150 cm Tree Width: 40 cm Diameter of Stand: 40 cm Number of Branch Tips: 295 Number of Sections: 2 Number of LED Lights: 110 Net Weight: 4 kg Cord Length: 300 cm Is Assembly Required: Yes Box QTY: 1(May vary by batch) Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

e6899q0t.baseName: Walplus 300 LEDs Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
e6899q0t.variantName: Walplus 300 LEDs Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
e6899q0t.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 105 cm Stand size: 45 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 210 Number of baubles: 120 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
